correctness.rationale: The helper implements the full inspectable settle-window contract: PR-number and env validation, allow-list load with [bot] stripping, head SHA reads before and after each GraphQL snapshot (including payload-head mismatch detection), polling loop with five RESULT= branches and documented exit codes, and machine-readable stdout with RESULT= and HEAD=. reduce_snapshot.py tracks PENDING reviews on the current head, filters reviews by commit.oid==head, and gates CONVERGED on zero pending and zero unresolved allow-listed bot threads. Bats mocks exercise CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR with matching status/output assertions. Minor non-fatal gaps: GraphQL pagination capped at reviews/reviewThreads first:100 with no continuation; unresolved-thread counting ignores isOutdated; CONVERGED requires participant_count>0 so zero-participating-bot PRs rely on QUIET_ELAPSED/TIMEOUT instead.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear and repo-consistent: set -euo pipefail, structured fail_result helper, mktemp+trap cleanup, stderr snapshot diagnostics, and focused ten-file diff. Documentation is broadly synced across pr-resolve-all.md (helper preference, per-RESULT dispatch, preserved 90s fallback), AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, scripts/README.md, scripts/lib/README.md, and commented bot-allowlist.txt. Minor deductions: snapshot logic is embedded as a runtime heredoc Python file rather than a reusable scripts/lib module; pr-resolve-all.md prose allow-list bullets may drift from the seven-entry canonical file; scripts/README.md indexes closeout.bats but not the new bats file.

reliability.rationale: scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats adds five mock-gh scenario tests covering CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and auth API_ERROR; scripts/checks/142-pr-resolve-all-poll-smoke.sh wires run_bats_check and objective test_wiring matched 2/2 with bash_n and lint passing.
